profile:
Systems engineer with a decade of experience building analytical engines and the software that drives them.

Takes projects from first sketch to working machine, and has led teams of four to ten.
key_achievements: Published the first algorithm intended for machine execution.
Designed a note-taking system that doubled the length of the original paper.
Led a team of six engineers across two research sites.
tech_leadership: Mentored junior engineers and established review practices.
Set technical direction across research and engineering.

selected_projects.name: Analytical Engine Notes
selected_projects.description: Algorithm and commentary for a general-purpose computing machine.

early_career.summary: Studied mathematics and mechanics, corresponding with leading engineers of the day.

experience.summary: Leads design work on general-purpose computing machinery.
highlights: Designed and documented the first published machine algorithm.
Built the notation used to describe engine operations.
Advised on the mechanical design of the engine's mill and store.

experience.summary: Researched mathematical methods for mechanical calculation.
highlights: Translated and expanded a foreign memoir on calculating engines.
Corresponded with engineers across Europe on machine design.
